## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Energy and Financials are showing clear strength while Big Tech exhibits mixed/soft price action, and leadership is Narrow (5/5 Energy) — supports a neutral stance with caution on concentration.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Financials follow: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND; Materials showing internal weakness: FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples/consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence in mega-cap techs (MSFT, AMZN, CSCO, AVGO) with 1W/1M mismatches — tactical risk, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed/internal rotation: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND, but AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth estimate: 13/24 positive → Internal Rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth estimate: 14/20 positive → Sector Strength (supports Value/Cyclical tilt).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Generally positive but mixed: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth estimate: 12/17 positive → Sector Strength, watch UNH legal headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Energy and Financials given clear ABOVE TREND leaders; reduce exposure to concentrated Tech names showing 1W weakness (AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND) and monitor big-cap divergence before increasing cyclical risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (10/10 positive estimate; 1W: +9.05%) and Financials (14/20 positive estimate). BEARISH: Consumer Staples (3/14 positive estimate; 1W: -3.32%) and Consumer Discretionary (5/14 positive estimate; 1W: -1.34%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch continuation signals rather than fixed prices: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND — confirmation if weekly momentum re-accelerates; AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim weekly losses signals further downside; XOM/CVX above-trend strength should hold 1W outperformance to confirm energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+80): J&J FDA clearance — JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. AMD (+50): AI product launch — AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. HON (+60): strong orders — HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, bullish headlines diverge from 1W price (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-90): legal headline — UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND, bearish news confirmed. META (-55): trial headlines — META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND, confirmed. MSFT (-50): China headwind — MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION, bearish sentiment diverges from strong 1M performance — monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style given Energy/Financials strength but concentrated leadership. XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: Narrow, Energy-dominated leadership and MAJOR divergence among mega-cap Tech (MSFT, AMZN, CSCO, AVGO) — watch sentiment-driven catalysts (UNH, JNJ) for next directional confirmation.
